g.text: Certificate Management: Component Boundary and Collaborators
Owns resource resolution, access policy, persistence
coordination, cache invalidation, and trust-store lifecycle.
It holds no private keys and no provider cryptographic objects.
One canonical parser serves the whole component, so a
certificate's derived identity (fingerprint, SKID, AKID) does not
vary with the caller that loaded it.
Resolving certificates and trust stores and counting references is
certificate-management state. Path validation is a provider
